_comment: Upstream source archives of the copyleft components shipped as binaries (GPL, LGPL, MPL). scripts/installer/fetch-sources.ps1 downloads them, checks the SHA-256 and copies them to dist/ next to the setup, to be published from the same place as the setup (GPL-2.0 section 3, GPL-3.0/LGPL-3.0 section 6(d), MPL-2.0 section 3.2(a)). Keep 'version' equal to what ships: constraints.txt for Python packages, packages/fem-viewer/package.json for web-ifc, resources/librecad/SAENGINE-BUNDLE.json (librecad_bundle.py) for entries with 'component': 'librecad' (LibreCAD itself and the Qt modules whose DLLs it ships, 'qt_module'); those are collected only when the build bundles LibreCAD; resources/libredwg/SAENGINE-BUNDLE.json (libredwg_bundle.py) for 'component': 'libredwg', collected only when the build bundles LibreDWG. Bump url, file and sha256 together. A null sha256 is not pinned yet: fetch-sources.ps1 refuses it unless run with -AllowUnpinned, then prints the hash to pin here.
